first_success: A user-requested change completed in the limited browser demo
summary: Five simulated personas reached browser-demo success after fixes; 10 of 11 merged issues fixed locally, 1 partially resolved pending native usage pricing.

issues.title: Unannounced automatic example and hidden demo limits
issues.change: The demo discloses its supported changes before entry, labels the example, offers Try it yourself, and explains its busy state.

issues.title: Ordinary “Make this bold.” request rejected
issues.change: Typed bold/bolder, serif, and blue requests now run the supported changes on selected text.

issues.title: Gui usage price missing before signup
issues.change: Cost and setup is linked beside the start actions. Download has no checkout and agent costs are separate. The price for native Gui use still needs an owner decision.

issues.title: Marketing subscription bundled with new accounts
issues.change: New accounts start with updates off; existing preferences survive. Sign-in, Terms, Privacy, docs and account tests agree. Human review is required before landing the account-service patch.

issues.title: Phone preview shrinks body text to about 9px
issues.change: At 375px the preview is 343px wide, with scale 0.914667 and its own scroll area.

issues.title: Phone suggestion and Undo buttons only 28px high
issues.change: Mobile suggestions, Undo, send and toolbar controls have at least 44px touch targets.

issues.title: Back leaves an open dialog flow
issues.change: Waitlist and demo use same-document history entries; Back closes and Forward restores. A regression also covers delayed dialog close events.

issues.title: Double-clicking the waitlist opener dismisses it
issues.change: Repeated backdrop clicks are ignored; the modal survives a double click. Duplicate submissions are guarded and pending work is cancelled when the dialog closes.

issues.title: Landing description assumes “agent harness” knowledge
issues.change: The hero explains select, describe, edit; Cost and setup names the Gui account and agent requirement.

issues.title: Download gives no next installation steps
issues.change: The download action reveals instructions for opening the DMG, installing Gui, signing in, choosing an agent and starting New canvas.

issues.title: Saving feedback uses the same red as errors
issues.change: Pending feedback now uses neutral text; error feedback retains red.

personas.name: The impatient one
personas.result: Download starts; installation guidance appears. Skipped the labeled example and typed “Make the words blue”; blue text and Undo appeared.

personas.name: The skeptic
personas.result: Cost/setup and legal links are visible. Marketing is optional in published copy. Own blue demo change succeeded. Native usage pricing remains unanswered.

personas.name: The mobile user
personas.result: 375 × 812, server throttle of 400 kbit/s plus 400ms latency. Readable preview, 44px controls, blue change, Undo, and phone download guidance succeeded.

personas.name: The literal reader
personas.result: Plain instructions, explicit demo limits and example skip. Exact previously rejected request “Make this bold.” succeeded on first submission.

personas.name: The breaker
personas.result: Junk stays text, duplicate send produces one turn, double-click opener stays open, Back/Forward recover both flows, and local waitlist and own blue change succeed.

verification.native: 1/1 passed: a new user signs in before Gui opens a project, then the project opens; isolated mock account service
verification.account: 29/29 service tests passed; new-account opt-in default and repeat-login preference preservation covered

limits: Gui browser demo success is established. Live WorkOS signup, agent login, native install and a real AI edit are not verified by the persona runs.

Mobile used a real 375px browser with a server-side 3G approximation. Browser UA remained desktop; the proxy forwarded iPhone UA to the Worker. Physical touch, a virtual keyboard, and radio behavior were not exercised.
This is a local patch; no deployment or commit was made. Price for native usage remains a product-owner decision.
Initial Astro download404, localhost IPv6 collision, local HTTPS/HSTS mismatch, and throttle-server cancellation outage were excluded from product counts.

The parallel website performance run was oversubscribed; a serial rerun passed all23 tests at opening/closing p95 16.7ms. Two assertions were updated for intended #demo history and existing custom-scrollbar class.
